topic: Typical school-day start/end times: London, Dublin, Toronto (TDSB), Vancouver (VSB)

findings.what: Typical UK primary school start and end times (general range)
findings.quote: Most primary schools in the UK begin between 8:30am and 9:00am, and primary schools often end the day between 3:00pm and 3:30pm

findings.what: Specific London primary school example (Rotherhithe Primary), Years 1-6 vs Reception
findings.value: Years 1-6: 8:55 line-up/9:00 start to 3:30 end; Reception: 9:00 start to 3:15 end
findings.quote: Year 1 to Year 6 pupils start with children lining up at 8:55am for a 9:00am start and ending at 3:30pm, while Reception pupils start at 9:00am and end at 3:15pm.

findings.what: UK school day total length (instructional time)
findings.quote: Children are in school for 6 hours and 30 minutes a day (Monday to Friday), during term time, which totals approximately 32.5 hours per week.

findings.what: Ireland primary school day length and typical start times
findings.value: 5 hours 40 minutes total; classes start between 8:30 and 9:30 am
findings.quote: The primary school day lasts 5 hours and 40 minutes... Classes usually start between 8:30am and 9.30am.

findings.what: Ireland primary school end times by class level
findings.value: Junior/Senior Infants: 1:10-2:00 pm; older classes: 2:10-3:00 pm
findings.quote: Children finish between 1.10 p.m. and 2 p.m. in Junior & Senior infants, while older children spend another hour in school and finish between 2:10 p.m. and 3 p.m.

findings.value: Supervision 8:35am, entry bell 8:45am, classes begin 8:50am; recess 10:10-10:25am; lunch 11:35am; afternoon entry 12:35pm; recess 1:55-2:10pm; day ends 3:20pm
findings.quote: Supervision begins at 8:35, Entry Bell at 8:45, Classes begin at 8:50... School Day ends at 3:20.

findings.what: TDSB specific school example, General Crerar (2026-2027)
findings.value: Supervision 8:30am, student entry 8:40am, day starts 8:45am, day ends 3:15pm
findings.quote: General Crerar has supervision starting at 8:30 am, student entry at 8:40 am, start of day at 8:45 am, and end of day at 3:15 pm for 2026-2027

findings.what: TDSB minimum daily instructional time requirement for elementary students
findings.quote: The TDSB expects all Elementary students to receive a minimum of 300 minutes of daily instruction.

findings.what: VSB (Vancouver) elementary bell schedule example, Trafalgar Elementary and General Brock Elementary
findings.quote: Trafalgar Elementary School has a start time of 8:00 AM and closing time of 3:30 PM.

findings.what: VSB elementary bell schedule example, Tecumseh Elementary (different timing)
findings.value: Warning bell 8:55am, instruction 9:00am, recess 10:30-10:45am, lunch 12:00-12:47pm, dismissal 3:00pm
findings.quote: Tecumseh Elementary School's bell schedule shows a warning bell at 8:55 AM, instruction begins at 9:00 AM, recess at 10:30-10:45 AM, lunch at 12:00-12:47 PM, and dismissal at 3:00 PM.

notFound.what: A single board-wide standardized VSB bell time (VSB schools clearly vary school-to-school, 8:00am-3:30pm vs 9:00am-3:00pm, with no single authoritative board-wide figure located)
looked: Vancouver School Board VSB elementary school start end time bell schedule
